translationsEn.:hongyuan: At Draw Phase, you can draw -1 card and let up to 2 other heroes draw 1.
translationsEn.:huaiyi: Once per action phase, can show all your hand cards. If they have different colors, you can choose one of the colors and discard all of this color from your hand. Then, you get 1 card from X heroes (X = #cards you discarded). If you get 2 or 2+ cards, then lose 1 HP.
translationsEn.:huanshi: Before a judgment result takes effect, you can make him to look at your hand and choose any of your cards. Then you play it and it becomes the new result.
translationsEn.:huilei: (forced) The hero who killed you discard all his cards.
translationsEn.:huimin: At End Phase can draw X cards (X = # of heroes whose hand < their HP); then, show X hand cards. Choose one of these heroes, starting from him each of them takes 1 of these cards.
translationsEn.:huisheng: When you suffer DMG from another hero, you can show him any cards, he must choose: a) Take 1 of these cards, prevent the DMG dealt to you and you cannot use this skill again on him; b) Discard same # of cards you showed.
translationsEn.:huituo: After you suffer DMG, can make a hero to be judged, if it’s: ▪ red, he heals 1; ▪ black, he draws X (X = number of this DMG).
translationsEn.:huomo: When you want to use a basic card that you haven't used in this turn, you can place a black non-basic card atop the deck, this is viewed as using the basic card.
translationsEn.:huxiao: In Action Phase, when your Slash is dodged, you can use +1 Slash.
translationsEn.:jiangchi: At Draw Phase, you can choose: a) Draw +1 card. This turn you cannot use/play Slash. b) Draw -1 card. This turn you can use +1 Slash and your Slash are rangeless.
translationsEn.:jianshu: (limited)  in Action Phase, you can give a black hand card to another hero (A) then choose a third hero (B) who has (A) in range. You make (A) Point Fight (B), the winner discards 2, the unwinner loses 1 HP.
translationsEn.:jianying: In Action Phase, when you use a card with the same suit or number as the previous card you used during the same phase, you can draw 1.
translationsEn.:jianzhengq: When another hero can reach you & he uses Slash on other hero(s), you can show & put a hand card atop the deck→ cancel all targets. If this Slash isn’t black, you become the target.
translationsEn.:jiaojin: When a male hero DMGs you, you can discard an equipment to suffer -1 DMG.
translationsEn.:jiefan: (limited) In Action Phase, you can choose a hero. Every hero who can reach him must discard a weapon or allow him to draw 1.
translationsEn.:jiexun:
At End Phase can choose another hero to draw X cards, then discards Y cards. If he discards all his cards, you lose this skill and rewrite Double Difficulty.
X= # ♦ on the field. Y= #times u activated this skill before.
translationsEn.:jieyue:
At End Phase, you can discard 1 hand card & choose another hero, unless he puts a card atop your hero (‘Battle-ax’), you discard 1 of his cards.
If you have a Battle-ax, you can use/play red hand cards as Dodge and black hand cards as Nullification. At the start of Beginning Phase, you get your Battle-ax.
translationsEn.:jigong: At Beginning of Action Phase you can draw 2 cards. Then, your hand limit is changed to X (X = DMG you dealt this turn).
translationsEn.:jijie: 1x Action Phase, you can see a card at the bottom of the deck, and then give it to a hero.
translationsEn.:jilei: After you suffer DMG, you can voice out a card type (basic, trick or equipment). The hero that dealt you DMG can’t use, play or discard hand cards of that type until the End of that Turn.
translationsEn.:jingce: At the end of Action Phase, if # of cards you have used this turn ≥ your HP, you can draw 2.
translationsEn.:jinjiu: (forced) Your Alcohol are viewed as Slash.
translationsEn.:jiqiao: At start of Action Phase, can discard any # of equipment (=X) → lay out the top 2X cards and get all tricks in them.
translationsEn.:jishe: In Action Phase, if hand limit > 0, can draw 1 → -1 hand limit this turn. ⁞ At End Phase, if you don’t have hand, can chain up to X heroes (X = HP).
translationsEn.:jiushi: When your hero is facing up, can flip → view it as using Alcohol. After you suffer DMG, if your hero is facing down, you can flip.
translationsEn.:jiyuan: When a hero enters the brink-of-death or when you give a card to another hero, you can make that hero draw 1.
translationsEn.:juece: At End Phase, you can deal 1 DMG to a hero who has no hand cards.
translationsEn.:juedi:
(forced) At Beginning Phase, you must choose:
a) Remove all Leading Troops and draw to #maxHP.
b) Give all Leading Troops(=X) to another hero whose HP≤ your HP, then he heals 1 and draws X cards.
translationsEn.:jueqing: (forced) Before you deal DMG, it is converted to "loss of health".
translationsEn.:juesi: In your action phase, can discard a Slash and choose a hero who has cards & is in your range. He must discard a card, if this card isn't Slash & your HP ≤ his HP, this is viewed as using a Duel on him.
translationsEn.:juexiang: After you die, can choose another hero to randomly gain one of these skills: ‘Harmonious Chord’, ‘Soft Chord’, ‘Fierce Chord’ or ‘Intense Chord’. Additionally, until his next turn, he cannot be targeted by ♣ cards.
translationsEn.:jujian: At End Phase, you can discard 1 non-basic card and let other hero choose: a) He draws 2; b) He heals 1; c) He restores his hero.
translationsEn.:junbing: At a hero's End Phase, if his on #hand < 2, he can draw 1. If he does so, he gives you all his hand cards and then you give back to him the same amount of cards.
translationsEn.:junwei:
At the End of Turn, you can discard 3 Brocades; then ask a player to choose:
A) Show 1 Dodge; then you pass it to any player.
B) Lose 1 HP; then you move out of the game 1 of his equipped cards. Once his turn has ended, the card is returned to its original position.
translationsEn.:junxing: Once per action phase, can choose another hero and discard any # of hand cards (=X). He must choose: a) discard 1 hand card of a different type than the ones you discarded; b) flip and draw X.
translationsEn.:juyi: (awaken) At Beginning Phase, if you r wounded & maxHP > survivors, draw to maxHP and gain the skills Disintegration and Majestic.
translationsEn.:jyie: (forced) When you use red Slash, the DMG is +1.
translationsEn.:kangkai: After a hero within distance 1 is targeted by Slash, you can draw 1. If you do so when another hero was targeted, you must give 1 card to him and let him show it. If the card is equipment, he can choose to use it.
translationsEn.:kuangbi: Once per action phase, can choose another hero who has cards, then he must choose from 1 to 3 of his cards to be placed besides your hero (“Eminence”). If you do so, at the start of your next turn, you get all “Eminence” (=X) and he draws X.
translationsEn.:kuiwei: At the start of End Phase, you can draw 2+X cards and flip. then at the start of your next Draw Phase, you must discard X cards. X = #Weapons on the board
translationsEn.:kunfen: (forced) At End Phase you must lose 1 HP, then draw 2.
translationsEn.:liangzhu: In any hero's turn, if that hero heals, you can choose: a) he draws 2; b) you draw 1.
translationsEn.:lianhuo: (forced) When you suffer Fire DMG, if you r chained and you are the 1st victim to suffer this damage, +1 DMG.
translationsEn.:lihun: 1x Action Phase, can discard 1 & flip →can take all hand cards of a male hero. At end of Action Phase, must return him X cards (X= his left HP).
translationsEn.:lihuo: When you use a normal Slash, you can view it as Fire Slash, if this Slash deals DMG, then you lose 1 HP. When you use Fire Slash, can have +1 target.
translationsEn.:linglong: (forced) If you don’t have equipped: ▪ Armor, regarded as having Eight Diagram equipped; ▪ Horse, +1 hand limit; ▪ Treasure: you have Genius.
translationsEn.:liyu: After you DMG another hero using Sha, you can take a card in his area → if it’s: ▪ not equipment, he draws 1; ▪ equipment, view it as you using Duel on another hero chosen by him.
translationsEn.:longyin: When a hero uses Slash in his Action Phase, you can discard a card to let this Slash doesn’t count. If you activate this skill in response to a red Slash, you draw 1.
translationsEn.:luoyan: (forced) If Star Dances ≥1, you are viewed as having Heavenly Scent and Shirk.
translationsEn.:luoying: After other hero’s ♣ discarded or judgement result cards r placed in the discard pile, you can get it.
translationsEn.:manjuan: Whenever you receive a card, you must place it in the discard pile. If this happens within your turn, then you can place in your hand a card with the same number from the discard pile.
translationsEn.:meibu: At the start of other hero’s Action Phase, if he cannot reach you, you can make his tricks are viewed as Slash for this turn → you are viewed as in his range.
translationsEn.:mieji: Once per action phase, you can put a black trick atop the deck and choose another hero with hand cards. He must discard 1 trick card or 2 non-trick cards.
translationsEn.:miji: At end phase, you can draw X cards. Then, you can give the same amount of hand cards to other heroes (X = #wounds).
translationsEn.:mingce: Once per action phase, you can give a Slash or equipment to another hero → he must choose: a) View it as using Slash on a hero of your choice in range. b) He draws 1.
translationsEn.:mingjian: Once per action phase, can give all hand to other hero → his next turn he will have +1 hand limit & can use +1 Slash.
translationsEn.:mingzhe: When you use, play or discard a red card outside of your turn, you can draw 1.
translationsEn.:mizhao: 1x Action Phase, can give all your hand to a hero (A) and choose a 2nd hero (B). A Point Fights B, the winner’s viewed as using Slash on the loser.
translationsEn.:mouduan:
You start the game being a "Warrior" (you possess Humility & Heated).
When your hand cards becomes ≤ 2, you must become "Strategist" (change those abilities to Handsome & Self Mastery).
You can become Warrior again by discarding a card before the Beginning of Turn of any player.
translationsEn.:moukui: After you use Slash, you can choose: a) draw 1; b) discard 1 of target’s cards. If you do either and he uses Dodge, he can discard one of your cards.
translationsEn.:mozhi: At End Phase, you can use 1 hand card as the 1st basic card or normal trick that you used this Action Phase. Then, can use 1 hand card as the 2nd basic card or normal trick that you used this Action Phase.
translationsEn.:mumu: If you doesn't dealt DMG in Action Phase, then at the start of the End Phase this turn, you can: A) Discard a weapon on the board and draw 1; B) Move a armor on the board to yours (can replace)
translationsEn.:naman: After other hero’s Slash played are placed in the discard pile, you can get it.
translationsEn.:nos__anguo: Once per action phase, can choose an equipped card of another hero and let him get it. If as a result there are fewer heroes within his range, you draw 1.
translationsEn.:nos__chengxiang: After you suffer DMG, can show the top 4 cards and get any of them which sum of values is < 13.
translationsEn.:nos__danshou: After you deal DMG, you can draw 1, then shut down all processes and end current turn.
translationsEn.:nos__enyuan: (forced) When you recover 1 HP from other hero, he draws 1. After you suffer DMG from other hero, you can make the source to choose: a) give you 1 <font color='red'>♥</font> hand card, or b) he loses 1HP.
translationsEn.:nos__fencheng: (limited) At your Play Phase, you can make all other heroes discard at least X cards or suffer 1 Fire DMG from you. X = max(# of his equipped cards, 1)
translationsEn.:nos__fuhun: At Draw Phase, you can change to show 2 cards from the top of draw pile and take them, if those cards are in different color, you gain Warrior Saint and Roar until the end of turn.
translationsEn.:nos__gongqi: You can use/play any equip card as unlimited-range Slash.
translationsEn.:nos__jiefan: Outside of your turn: when a hero is on the brink-of-death, you can use Slash to current turn’s hero, if that Slash make DMG, prevent it and view it as use a Peach to that hero who is on the brink-of-death.
translationsEn.:nos__juece: In your turn: When a hero lose his last hand card, you can deal 1 DMG to him.
translationsEn.:nos__jujian: Once per action phase, you can discard up to 3 cards, make an other hero draw the same amount cards, if your discard 3 same-type cards, you heal 1.
translationsEn.:nos__mieji: When your black non-delay trick targeting only 1 target, you can have +1 target.
translationsEn.:nos__miji: At Beginning and End Phase, if you are wounded, you can be judged. If black: see the top X cards then give them to any heroes. (X = your #wounds).
translationsEn.:nos__qianxi: When you DMG your target using Slash, you can be judged. If it’s not ♥ you prevent the DMG and he loses -1 maxHP.
translationsEn.:nos__qiuyuan: When you r target of Slash, you can target a 3rd hero (with cards) who must give you a hand card, if that is not Dodge, he become an additional target to Slash.
translationsEn.:nos__renxin: When other hero is on the brink-of-death, you can flip and give all your hand cards (at least 1) to him, then he heal to 1 HP.
translationsEn.:nos__taoxi: Once per action phase, when you single-targeted another player, you can reveal him 1 hand card until the end of turn; you can use this card in this turn. When this turn ends, if he didn't lose that card, you lose 1 HP.
translationsEn.:nos__wuyan: (forced) Non-delay trick card used to or by you has no effect.
translationsEn.:nos__xuanfeng: After you lose equipped cards, you can choose: a) View it as using Slash; b) Deal 1 DMG to a player at distance 1.
translationsEn.:nos__xuanhuo: Once per action phase, you can give a <font color='red'>♥</font> hand card to another hero. Then you get a card from him and you give it to a third hero.
translationsEn.:nos__zhenlie: Before your judgement result card takes effect, you can replace it by showing the top card.
translationsEn.:nos__zhuikong: At other hero’s Start of Turn, if you are wounded, you can Point Fight him. During this turn: If you win, skip his Play Phase. If you don’t win, the distance from him to you becomes 1.
translationsEn.:pingkou: At the End of Turn, you can deal 1 DMG to up to X other heroes (X= #of phases you skipped this turn).
translationsEn.:pizhuan: After you use or become the target of another hero's ♠ card, you can put the top card of the deck atop your hero ("Book"). You can have up to 4 Books. Your hand limit has +X (X = #Books).
translationsEn.:pojun: After you deal DMG with Slash, you can make another player draw X card(s) then turn over. (X = his HP, max. 5).
translationsEn.:qiangwu: 1x Action Phase, you can be judged. Until the end of turn, your Slash which value is _ the result are: <, rangeless; >, countless.
translationsEn.:qiangzhi: At start of Action Phase, can show a hand card from another hero. When you use a card of the same type during your turn, you can draw 1.
translationsEn.:qianju: (forced) If you are wounded, you have –X distance bonus (X = #wounds).
translationsEn.:qianxi: At Prepare phase, you can perform a judgement, and then choose a hero at distance 1. Until the End of Turn, he cannot use/play hand cards of the same color that result is.
translationsEn.:qianxin: (awaken) After you deal DMG, if you are wounded, then -1 maxHP and gain Suggest.
translationsEn.:qiaomeng: When you use black Slash, after you DMG a hero, you can discard a card in any of his areas. After the card goes into the discard pile, if it is a horse, you get it.
translationsEn.:qiaoshi: At other hero's End Phase, if his hand cards = yours, you can let you and him draw 1 card each.
translationsEn.:qiaoshui: At start of Action Phase, you can Point Fight. This turn, if you: ▪ win, you can have +1/-1 target (distance-less) on your next basic or normal trick card; ▪ don’t win, you cannot use trick.
translationsEn.:qice: Once per action Phase, can use all your hand cards (at least 1) as any non-delay trick card.
translationsEn.:qieting: At the end of other hero's turn, if he did not specifically target another hero you can either draw 1 or move 1 of his equipped cards to yours.
translationsEn.:qingxi: When you DMG your target using Slash, if you’ve a weapon in your equipment area, can make the target to choose: a) Discard X hand cards (X = your range) → he discards your weapon; b) suffer +1 DMG.
translationsEn.:qingxian: After you suffer DMG / heal, you can make the source / another hero to: a) Lose 1 HP and use a random equipment card; or b) Heal 1 and discard an equipment card. If the equipped/discarded equipment is ♣, you heal 1.
translationsEn.:qinqing: At End Phase, can choose any heroes who can reach the king, discard each of them a card and then make them draw 1 → you draw X (X = among the heroes you chose, # of heroes whose hand > the king's hand).
translationsEn.:qinwang: (lord) You can discard 1 to trigger Rouse. If there is a response, that hero draws 1.
translationsEn.:qinxue: (awaken) At Beginning Phase, if hand cards ≥ HP+3, (or hand ≥ HP+2 if 7+ survivors), -1 maxHP and gain Strike at the Heart
translationsEn.:qiuyuan: When you're target of Slash, you can target a 3rd hero (with cards) who must give you a Dodge or become an additional target to this Slash.
translationsEn.:quanji: After each 1 of DMG you suffer, you can draw 1, then place 1 hand card atop your hero ("Power"). You have +X hand limit (X = #Powers).
translationsEn.:quji: 1x Action Phase, can discard X cards, then choose up to X hurt heroes to heal 1. If any of the discarded cards was black, you lose 1 HP. (X = #wounds)
translationsEn.:re__anxu: 1x Action Phase, can choose other 2 heroes with different #hand cards. The hero with more hand cards must give 1 hand card to the other.if then they have the same #hand cards, you draw 1 or heal 1.
translationsEn.:re__pojun: In Action Phase, after you target using Slash, you can place the target’s X cards besides his hero (X = his HP). At the end of the turn he gets all these cards.
translationsEn.:re__qianxi: At Beginning Phase, you can draw 1, discard a card and then choose a hero at distance 1. Until the End of Turn, he cannot use/play cards of the same color that you discarded.
translationsEn.:re__zishou: At Draw Phase, you can draw +X cards (X = #dynasties). If you do so, this turn you cannot target other heroes.
translationsEn.:renxin: When other hero with 1 HP suffers DMG, you can flip & discard an equipment → prevent this DMG.
translationsEn.:sanyao: 1x Action Phase, can discard a card, then deal 1 DMG to the hero with the most HP.
translationsEn.:shangshi: When #hand cards < #wounds, you can replenish your hand card to #wounds.
translationsEn.:shenduan: When one of your black basic cards is discarded, after it is placed into the discard pile, you can place it to other hero’s judgement area as Supply Shortage.
translationsEn.:shenxian: when other hero discards a basic card outside your turn, you can draw 1.
translationsEn.:shenxing: In Action Phase can discard 2 → draw 1.
translationsEn.:shibei: (forced) After you suffer DMG, if it is the first time during the current turn, you heal 1. Otherwise you lose 1 HP.
translationsEn.:shichou: Your Slash can target +X heroes. X = #wounds.
translationsEn.:shichoul: (lord, limited) At the Beginning of Turn, can choose a Shu player and give him 2 cards. Whenever you suffer DMG, transfer this DMG to him; then he draws as many cards as DMG suffered. This ability will perpetuate until he enters brink of death for the first time.
translationsEn.:shifei: When you want to use/play Dodge, you can let the current turn’s hero to draw 1 → if he isn't the only one who has the most hand cards, you can discard 1 card from a hero who has the most hand cards → view it as using Dodge.
translationsEn.:shiyong: (forced) After you suffer DMG from red Slash or Alcoholed Slash, you -1 maxHP.
translationsEn.:shizhi: (forced) When your HP is 1, your Dodge are always Slash.
translationsEn.:shouxi: After you become the target of Slash, you can name a basic or trick card (only once per name); unless the source discards the card you named and takes 1 card from you, the Slash becomes ineffective.
translationsEn.:sidi: When you or other hero(in your turn) use Dodge, you can put 1 card from deck to your hero(“EForesight”). At other hero’s start of Play Phase, you can put 1 EForesight to Discard pile, and that hero can use -1 Slash this phase.
translationsEn.:songci: 1x hero, in Action Phase, you can choose a hero. If his hand > his HP, he must discard 2 cards. If his HP > his hand, he draws 2 cards.
translationsEn.:sp__yanyu: At the Beginning of any player’s Action Phase, you can discard a card. If you do so, whenever a card of the same type you discarded goes into the discard pile during current player’s action phase, you may take it and give it to a player.(Up to 3 times this phase).
translationsEn.:sp__zhuiji: (forced) All heroes whose HP < yours, are considered at distance 1 from you.
translationsEn.:std__kuangfu: (forced) After you DMG your target using Sha, if it's in your Action Phase and you don’t activated this skill yet, when his HP is: ▪ < yours, you draws 2; ▪ ≥ yours, you lose 1 HP.
translationsEn.:suiren: (limited) At Beginning Phase, you can lose Righteous Cavalry, gain +1 maxHP, heal 1 and allow a hero to draw 3 cards
translationsEn.:tanhu:
1x Action Phase, can Point Fight with another player. If you win, you acquire the following abilities till the end of your turn:
-Your distance from him is 1. -Delayed tricks used on him cannot be neutralized by Nullification.
translationsEn.:taoluan: can use a card as any basic card or normal trick (the card you create cannot be one you already created this game) → make another hero to choose: a) Give you 1 cards which types are different to the one you created; b) You lose 1 HP and cannot use this skill again this turn.
translationsEn.:tianbian: When you Point Fight, can use the card atop the deck instead. When you use a ♥ card in a Point Fight, it’s always viewed as a K.
translationsEn.:tianming: After you become target of Slash, you can: discard 2, draw 2. If there is a hero whose HP > all other heroes, he can choose to also perfrom this effect.
translationsEn.:tongbo: After the end of Draw Phase, can exchange any of your cards with any of your Books. If your Books’re of 4 different suits, give all your Books to another hero.
translationsEn.:tongji: (forced) If # hand cards > HP, heroes who have you in their range must target you with every Slash they use.
translationsEn.:wangxi: After you deal/suffer DMG to/by a hero, for each unit, you can draw 1 → the other hero will also draw 1.
translationsEn.:wangzun: At lord’s Beginning Phase, you can draw 1 → he has -1 hand limit this turn.
translationsEn.:weidi: (forced) You possess the ruler ability of the current ruler.
translationsEn.:wengua: Once per action phase of every hero, he can give you 1 card; you can place it on the top or bottom of the deck → you and he draw 1 from the other end of the deck.
translationsEn.:wuji: (awaken) At End Phase, if this turn u’ve dealt ≥ 3 DMG, then gain +1 maxHP, heal 1, lose Tiger Howl.
translationsEn.:wurong: Once per action phasee, can choose another hero, then both of you show simultaneously one card from your hand. If your card is Slash & his is not Dodge, you discard your Slash and deal him 1 DMG. If your card is not Slash & his is a Dodge, you discard your card and take 1 of his cards.
translationsEn.:wuyan: (forced) DMG dealt or suffered from trick card is prevented.
translationsEn.:xiansi: At Beginning Phase, can choose up to 2 other heroes, take a card from each and put them atop your hero (“Betrayals”). When other hero wants to use Slash on you, he can remove 2 Betrayals and view it as using Slash on you.
translationsEn.:xiantu: At other heroes’ start of Action Phase, you can draw 2 → give the target 2 cards, if he ends this phase without killing another hero, you lose 1 HP.
translationsEn.:xianzhen: Once per action phase, you can Point Fight. This turn, if you: ▪ win, ignore his distance and equipped armor and you can use unlimited Slash on him, ▪ don’t win, you cannot use Slash.
translationsEn.:xianzhou: (limited) In your Action Phase you can give another hero all your equipped cards. The target then decides to let you heal X or to DMG up to X heroes in his range (X = #cards that you gave).
translationsEn.:xiaode: When other hero dies, you can choose one of his character card skills (except awakening or ruler). Until the End of your Turn: gain that skill and lose Filial Piety.
translationsEn.:xiemu: 1x Action Phase, you can discard a Slash and choose a kindom, then until your next turn start, when that kindom's other hero uses black card targeted to some players, if including you, you can draw 2.
translationsEn.:xingshuai: (lord, limited) When you enter the brink of death, can ask every Wei hero if he lets you heal 1. The heroes who let you will then suffer 1 DMG from no source.
translationsEn.:xingwu: At start of Discard Phase, you can place 1 hand card (of a different color from any card you have used this turn) atop your hero (‘Star Dance’) → if you have 3+ Star Dances, remove all Star Dances, deal 2 DMG to a male hero and discard all his equipped cards.
translationsEn.:xingxue: At End Phase, can choose up to X heroes to draw 1 card and place 1 card atop the deck. X = HP, if you lost Punish on Festival, X = maxHP instead.
translationsEn.:xinzhan: Once per action phase, if your #hand cards > max HP, you can examine 3 cards from the deck, then show and take any amount of <font color='red'>♥</font> card inside, and place the rest at the top in any order.
translationsEn.:xuanfeng: After you lose equipped cards, or when you discard 2 or more cards in Discard Phase, you can discard a total of 2 cards (in order) from up to 2 other heroes.
translationsEn.:xuanhuo: At Draw Phase can instead make another hero to draw 2 cards, then let that hero use a Slash on other hero of your choice that is in his range. If he doesn’t use Slash, you take 2 of his cards.
translationsEn.:xuehen:
At the End of Turn of every player, if your HP card is vertical, you must rotate it back to horizontal, then choose one:
A) Discard X cards from the player who's turn is ending (X = #wounds). B) View it as using Slash on any player.
translationsEn.:xueji: 1x Action Phase, can discard a red card and deal 1 DMG to up to X heroes in range. Then each of them draws 1. (X = wounds).
translationsEn.:xunxun: At start of Draw Phase, can see the top 4 cards, put 2 of them atop the deck in any order and the rest on the bottom.
translationsEn.:yajiao: When you use/play a hand card outside of your turn, you can show the top card. If it is the same type as the one you just used/played, you can give it to a hero. If not, you can discard a card in any area of a hero in range.
translationsEn.:yanxiao:
During Action Phase, can place any of your ♦ cards into the judgement area of a player (‘Smile’).
At the Beginning Phase of any player with a ‘Smile’, he places all cards in his judgement area into his hand.
translationsEn.:yanyu: In Action Phase, you can recast Slash. At end of Action Phase, if this turn you used this skill 2 or 2+ times, you can choose 1 other male hero to draw 2.
translationsEn.:yanzheng: If your #hand cards > your HP, you can use use a equipped card as Nullification.
translationsEn.:yanzhu: Once per action phase, can make a hero to choose: a) You take all his equipped items and lose this skill; b) He discards 1.
translationsEn.:yaowu: (forced) When you suffer DMG from Slash, if that Slash is: ▪ red, source draws 1 or heal 1; ▪ not red, you draw 1.
translationsEn.:yicong: When HP > 2, the distance from you to other players is reduced by -1. When HP ≤ 2, the distance from other players to you is increased by 1.
translationsEn.:yinbing: At End Phase, you may place any # of non-basic cards atop your hero (‘Leading Troops’). When you suffer DMG from Slash or Duel, you must remove one of them.
translationsEn.:yingbing: When a Curse becomes the judgment result, you can draw 2.
translationsEn.:yinling: During Action Phase, can discard 1 black card, then you take 1 card from another player, then place that card atop your character (‘Brocade’). Max # of Brocades = 4.
translationsEn.:yizhong: (forced) If you don’t have any armor equipped, black Slash has no effect on you.
translationsEn.:yongdi: (limited) after you suffer DMG, you can make another male hero to gain +1 maxHP → if he has a ruler ability and he isn't the ruler, he gains the ruler ability.
translationsEn.:yongsi: (forced) At Draw Phase, draw +X cards. At the start of the Discard Phase, discard X cards. (X= # dynasties still in play).
translationsEn.:youdi: At End Phase, you can make another hero discard you 1 card, if it’s not Slash, you take 1 of his cards.
translationsEn.:yuanhu:
At the start of your finish phase, you can place 1 equipment in the equipment area of a hero: If it’s:
▪ weapon, discard 1 card on any area of a hero at distance 1 from your target;
▪ armor, target draws 1;
▪ horse, target heals 1.
translationsEn.:yuce: After you suffer DMG, can show 1 hand card. The source must discard a card of a different type or you heal 1.
translationsEn.:zenhui: Once per action phase, when you use Slash or a black normal trick on a single-target, you can choose another hero who could be a legal target for this card. He must decide to: a) become a target, or b) to give you a card and then become the user of the card used.
translationsEn.:zhanjue: In Action Phase, can use all hand cards as 1 Duel. After it’s resolved, you and the hero who suffers DMG draw 1. If this turn you have drawn 2+ cards this way, you cannot activate this skill until the end of phase.
translationsEn.:zhaofu: (lord, forced) Every hero who is at distance 1 is viewed as in range of all other Wu heroes
translationsEn.:zhaolie:
At Draw Phase, can draw 1 card less; then ask a player within your attack range to show the top 3 cards from the deck, among them discard the non-basic and Peach cards. He must choose one:
a) You inflict X DMG on him; then he takes the remaining basic cards.
B) He discards X cards; then you take the remaining basic cards. (X = # of non-basic cards discarded).
translationsEn.:zhaxiang: (forced) After you lose HP, for each unit, draw 3 cards. If it is during Action Phase: ▪ you can use +1 Slash, ▪ your red Slash are rangeless & cannot be dodged.
translationsEn.:zhenlie: After you become the target of other hero’s used Slash or non-delay trick, you can lose 1 HP. If you do so, the card becomes ineffective on you and you discard him a card.
translationsEn.:zhenshan: Once per turn, when you need to use/play a basic card, you can exchange your hand cards with another player who has fewer hand cards than yours, then you are regarded as use/play that card.
translationsEn.:zhenwei:
When other hero is the only target of Slash or black trick card and his HP < yours, you can discard 1 and choose:
a) Draw 1 → you become the target;
b) Make the card ineffective → at the end of the current turn, he gets this card.
translationsEn.:zhichi: (forced) Outside your turn, after you suffer DMG, Slash & non-delay tricks are ineffective on you until that turn ends.
translationsEn.:zhige: Once per action phase, if hand > HP, can make a hero who can reach you to choose: a) Use a Slash; b) Give you a card from his equipment area.
translationsEn.:zhiman: When you DMG another hero, you can prevent it, if you do so, take a card from his field.
translationsEn.:zhiyan: At End Phase, you can make a hero draw 1 and show it. If it’s equipment, he uses it and heals 1.
translationsEn.:zhiyu: After you suffer DMG, you can draw 1, then show all your hand cards. If all them are of the same color, the source must discard 1 hand card.
translationsEn.:zhongjian: Once per action phase, can show 1 hand card, then show X cards from another hero (X = your hand cards – your HP). If any of his cards: ▪ matches your card’s color, you draw 1 card or discard 1 card from a hero other than you; ▪ matches your value, this skill can be activated twice this turn; ▪ no match: -1 hand limit.
translationsEn.:zhongyong: When you use Slash (in your action phase), after it is resolved by Dodge, you can give this Dodge used by your target to another hero. if not you, you may use Slash on your target.
translationsEn.:zhoufu: 1x Action Phase, you can place a hand card besides a hero (“Curse”) who isn’t Cursed. When he is judged the Curse becomes the result. At his End of Turn, you get the Curse back.
translationsEn.:zhuandui: After you target a hero with Slash / you become the target of Slash, you can Point Fight him. If you win, he cannot respond this Slash / this Slash becomes ineffective on you.
translationsEn.:zhuhai: At other hero’s End Phase, if he dealt DMG his turn, you can use Slash on him.
translationsEn.:zhuiji: (forced) Your distance is 1 to all heroes whose HP < yours.
translationsEn.:zhuikong: At other hero’s Start of Turn, if you are wounded, you can Point Fight him. During this turn: If you win, he cannot use cards to target anyone other than himself. If you don’t win, the distance from him to you becomes 1.
translationsEn.:zhuiyi: When you die, can choose another hero (not who killed you) to draw 3 cards and heal 1.
translationsEn.:zhuji: When a hero deals Thunder DMG, you can let him to be judged. If it is black, the damage is +1. If it’s red, he gets the judgement card.
translationsEn.:zili: (awaken) At Beginning Phase, if Power >= 3, then -1 maxHP, either heal 1 or draw 2, and gain Eradicate.
translationsEn.:zishou: At Draw Phase, you can draw +X cards (X = #wounds), then skip your action phase.
translationsEn.:zongshi: (forced) Your hand limit has +X (X = #dynasties in alive players).
translationsEn.:zongshij: After you Point Fight, if you: ▪ win, can get the Point Fight’s opponent’s card; ▪ don’t win, can get your Point Fight’s card.
translationsEn.:zongxuan: After your cards are discarded, after being placed in the discard pile, you can place them atop the deck in any order.
translationsEn.:zongzuo: (forced) At start of the game, gain +X maxHP and heal X (X = dynasties in the game). After the last hero of each dynasty dies, -1 maxHP.
translationsEn.:zuixiang:
(limited) At the Beginning of Turn, can show 3 cards from the top of the deck and place them on your character (‘Plastered’).
You cannot use/play any card of the same type as your ‘Plastered’. Cards of the same type also have no effect on you.
For every turn henceforth, you must repeat Plastered until any 2 ‘Plastered’ have the same #, if so, place all your ‘Plastered’ in your hand.
translationsEn.:zuoding: During other hero’s action phase, after he targets a hero using ♠, if no one has suffered DMG this turn, can make 1 of the targets to draw 1.
translationsEn.qinwang: Send Troops to Rescue the King
